steps.action: Negative: Create contract refuses a blank Title, a missing Contract type, a blank required Field and an invalid number; archived references are not offered; Cancel creates nothing
steps.expected: Each refusal shows an error in the dialog and no Contract is created; archived type, Entity and person are absent.
steps.actual: Blank Create said "Name the contract."; with a Title only it said "Pick a contract type.". The type list omitted archived "Framework agreement"; Owner omitted archived Gabriel Santos and Business Users and started on Daniel Okafor. The fixture type showed its required and optional Fields; blank required Field said "Fill DOC-029r2 contracts-a Required number 1789582005354 — this contract type requires it."; a non-number said "DOC-029r2 contracts-a Required number 1789582005354: enter this as a number.". Cancel on a complete draft closed the dialog; the Contracts API lists no Contract with that title.

steps.action: Create the record: Title, Contract type, Fields, Owner, Confidential, optional Matter search, Create
steps.expected: The app opens the new Contract with its title, type, Legal Owner and a new C- reference, in the Draft Status; the chosen Owner is Legal Owner and the creator is on the team as Creator.
steps.actual: The dialog selected Matter "M-16" (help text in dialog: "Link only when this Contract is part of broader Matter work. Nothing else flows across the link."). Create opened /contracts/121 directly. Header: "Contracts C-121 DOC-029r2 contracts-a administrator C14 1789582005354 Draft Draft Review Approval Signature Active Ended". Overview Contract type MSA, Legal Owner "NH Nadia Haddad"; Confidential true; the Governing law Field saved. Contract team: "Contract team NH Legal Owner Nadia Haddad DO Creator Daniel Okafor". MSA has 0 default people, so no one else joined.

steps.action: A link does not copy access: a Legal Team Member outside the Confidential team reads the Matter but not the Contract
steps.expected: The Matter answers; the Confidential Contract is refused for the reader outside its team.
steps.actual: Marcus Oyelaran: Matter M-16 answered 200; Contract C-121 answered 404; his page did not show the title ("C-121 does not exist, or you cannot open it. Back to Contracts").

steps.expected: The reference stays the same after a rename.

steps.action: Counterparties: search, inspect the create action, link two, Make primary, remove one link
steps.expected: A new name offers a create action; the first linked party is primary; Make primary moves the designation; removing a link keeps the Counterparty record.
steps.actual: Typing a new name offered "Create \"DOC-029r2 contracts-a administrator Counterparty 1789582005354\""; selecting it linked the new Counterparty as primary. Litware Insurance Company was linked second. Make primary moved the Primary designation to Litware. "Take DOC-029r2 contracts-a administrator Counterparty 1789582005354 off the contract" left one linked party, and the Counterparty search still returns the record.

steps.action: Contract team: Add team member > Person > Add; membership rows and separate statements; removing membership keeps the Business Owner statement
steps.expected: One row per person; Legal Owner, Business Owner and Creator show as statements; taking a person off the team leaves their Business Owner statement.
steps.actual: Membership after Add: ["Daniel Okafor","Jonas Weber"]; roster rows ["DO Legal Owner Creator Daniel Okafor","JW Business Owner Jonas Weber"]. After "Take Jonas Weber off the contract team" membership is ["Daniel Okafor"], yet the roster still shows ["DO Legal Owner Creator Daniel Okafor","JW Business Owner Jonas Weber"] and the record still names Jonas Weber as Business Owner. Re-added: ["DO Legal Owner Creator Daniel Okafor","JW Business Owner Jonas Weber"].

steps.action: Maintain the values on Fields: text saves on leave or Enter; a choice saves when selected; Escape abandons an unsaved edit
steps.expected: Blur and Enter save; Escape restores the saved value without a save; choices save immediately.
steps.actual: Jurisdiction saved on Tab; Liability cap saved on Enter; an Escape after typing "Unsaved edit" restored "Fees paid in 12 months" and the stored value stayed "Fees paid in 12 months"; Our position Customer saved on selection.
